head: codex/5658-bound-worktree-lifecycle
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][tooling] Keep lifecycle writes in bound worktree
body:
Closes #5658

Keeps typed C-SDLC v2 bind lifecycle writes rooted in the declared issue worktree instead of advancing primary-main issue state during non-local bind. The bind path now materializes issue records, prepared artifacts, evidence roots, and locks into the registered target Git worktree before committing the bound transition there.

Hardening included the pre-PR review findings: unregistered target directories fail closed, symlinked lifecycle state is rejected, created-worktree failures are compensated, evidence is copied with issue state, stale existing target lifecycle/prepared/evidence state fails closed before side-state mutation, gate2 standalone expectations use worktree-owned lifecycle state, and idempotent rebind verifies the target issue/repository/initialization_digest tuple before returning success.

Focused validation:
- `cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate2 --test gate7_lifecycle` passed locally on FastWork with gate2 47 passed and gate7_lifecycle 33 passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed.
- `csdlc-doctor --repo . --issue 5658` passed at reviewed generation 10.

Pre-PR review: bounded subagent review is clean for the substantive source/test revision `d29836f671df537b6bb3e18ba4dd34f55119350e`; current publication head `a5c122c06c1f0d5e76ce2301f19dac8341eeff33` adds typed review metadata only.
